description:
The Kong service will be deployed under the name **kong** with two instances, each allocated 1 CPU share and 1024 MB of memory, and no node‑role restriction (role “*”).  

Configuration wise, the deployment is set to use PostgreSQL as its backing data store, with migrations enabled. PostgreSQL is reachable at **postgresql.marathon.l4lb.thisdcos.directory** on port **5432**, using the database **kong**, user **kong**, and password **supersecret**. Although Cassandra is not the primary store, its connection details are provided: contact points **cassandra-1.node.cassandra.l4lb.thisdcos.directory,cassandra-2.node.cassandra.l4lb.thisdcos.directory**, keyspace **kong**, and port **9042**. The log level is set to **notice**, and additional environment variables are defined as **KONG_CUSTOM_PLUGIN=off** and **KONG_ANONYMOUS_REPORTS=on**.  

For networking, the Admin interface will not expose an external VIP; it listens internally on VIP port **8001** (SSL 8444) and is reachable externally via service port **10202** if needed, with the virtual host **admin.kong.mesos** and HTTP‑to‑HTTPS redirection disabled. The Proxy endpoint is exposed through an external VIP, listening on service port **10201** and redirecting HTTP to HTTPS; internally it uses VIP port **8000** (SSL 8443) and the virtual host **api.kong.mesos**.
